discoveries.summary: SELECT_AUTOSUBS. Pin AutoSubs v3.8.0 (tmoroney/auto-subs, MIT) Windows x86_64 release. Headless interface: autosubs <input> --model small --lang zh --no-gpu --format json; exit 0/1/2; stdout JSON only, stderr progress/errors. JSON Transcript={processing_time_sec,language,segments:[{start,end,text,speaker_id?,words?}],originalSegments,speakers}; normalize seconds to existing cue_id/start_ms/end_ms/text. Whisper GGML multilingual small is 480MB/2GB RAM; code/model path MIT; prohibit --forced-alignment (MMS CC-BY-NC) and model families whose licenses are not independently approved. Auto-download/cache and missing binary/model, ffmpeg, malformed/zero cues, nonzero exit, timeout are actionable failures. Vibe v3.0.23 MIT is not selected: its CLI blindly forwards args to bundled opaque sona.exe and its documented model setup is manual/GUI; no installed executable. Internal control is Faster-Whisper 1.2.1 + bundled Systran/faster-whisper-small (MIT, 483.5MB), CPU int8/local-only, but not external. Worker: build a subprocess-only provider adapter; explicit binary/version/model-cache preflight, bounded timeout/cancel, temp JSON parse/validate, no translation flag/download fallback, preserve source track, integration tests.
